name: Produced capital per capita (real chained 2019 US$)
sourceNote: Produced capital includes the value of machinery, buildings, equipment, and residential and nonresidential urban land.    Values are measured at market exchange rates in constant 2018 US dollars, using a country-specific GDP deflator.
sourceOrganization: World Bank. 2021. The Changing Wealth of Nations 2021: Managing Assets for the Future. Washington, DC: World Bank. doi:10.1596/978-1-4648-1590-4.
